description: 伦敦体系——观察每步如何积累子力控制，17步练习注释

intro.popup: 观察白方每步如何让轻子控制格子越来越多！追踪每步后白方对中心四格的控制数量变化——每步棋都应让子力控制更多中心格
intro.popup_en: Watch how White's minor pieces control more squares with each move. Track the number of central squares influenced after every move; each move should add to that control.

outro.popup: 每步棋都应让子力控制更多中心格。伦敦体系最后的 Ne5 是积累的顶点——当 9 步的控制积累到最高点，中心马 Ne5 就成为整个阵型不可撼动的支柱。
outro.popup_en: Each move should add to your control of the center. In the London System, Ne5 is the culmination of that buildup: after nine moves of preparation, the central knight becomes a firm pillar of the position.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 1.Nf3 — 控制+2格！
f3 马控制 e5 和 d4。中心控制计数：e5✓ d4✓（2格）
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 1.Nf3 - Control two central squares!
The knight on f3 controls e5 and d4. Count: e5 and d4 (2 squares).

moves.popup:
⬇️ 1...d5 — 黑方占领 d5！
黑方直接用兵占中心。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 1...d5 - Black occupies d5!
Black claims a central square with a pawn.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 2.d4 — 兵占中心，控制+稳固！
d4 兵占领中心格，e5 格受到 d4+Nf3 双重控制。计数：d4(占)✓ e5(双控)✓
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 2.d4 - Occupy and reinforce the center!
The d-pawn occupies d4, while e5 is controlled by both d4 and Nf3. Count: d4 occupied; e5 doubly controlled.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 2...Nf6 — 黑马攻击 d5！
黑马出动，加强对 d5 和 e4 的控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 2...Nf6 - Black develops and attacks d5!
The knight adds control over d5 and e4.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 3.Bf4 — 象加入！e5 受三子控制！
f4 象控制 e5（f4→e5 斜线！）。现在 e5 格受到 Nf3+d4+Bf4 三子控制！
计数：d4(占)✓ e5(三控)✓
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 3.Bf4 - The bishop joins the pressure!
The bishop on f4 controls e5 along the diagonal. Now Nf3, d4, and Bf4 all influence e5.
Count: d4 occupied; e5 controlled by three units.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 3...e6 — 黑方稳固阵型。
e6 支撑 d5，为象开路。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 3...e6 - Black solidifies the position.
The pawn supports d5 and opens a diagonal for the bishop.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.e3 — 开放象线，支撑 d4。
e3 打开 f1 象的路，同时支撑 d4。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 4.e3 - Open the bishop's diagonal and support d4.
e3 clears the way for the bishop on f1 and reinforces d4.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 4...Bd6 — 黑象挑战白方 Bf4！
黑象 d6 瞄准 e5，与白方 Bf4 争夺 e5 格的控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 4...Bd6 - Black challenges the bishop on f4!
The bishop on d6 also eyes e5 and contests White's control of that square.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 5.Bg3 — 象退守，保持 e5 控制！
Bf4 主动与黑象 Bd6 交换后退到 g3，避免双象兑换，保持对 e5 的斜线控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 5.Bg3 - Retreat while keeping control of e5!
The bishop backs away from the challenge instead of exchanging, preserving its diagonal influence on e5.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 5...O-O — 黑方易位。
黑方易位，完成基础阵型。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 5...O-O - Black castles.
Black completes the basic setup and secures the king.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 6.Nbd2 — 第二马出动！
d2 马准备跳向 e4 或 f3，进一步加强中心控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 6.Nbd2 - Develop the second knight!
The knight may head to e4 or f3 to add further central control.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 6...c5 — 黑方挑战 d4！
黑方推 c5，测试 d4 的稳固性。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 6...c5 - Black challenges d4!
The c-pawn tests the stability of White's central pawn.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 7.c3 — 保护 d4！
c3 支撑 d4 兵，不让黑方的 c5 轻易吃掉 d4。中心兵得到坚实保护。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 7.c3 - Protect d4!
The c-pawn supports d4 and makes it harder for Black to capture it with ...c5. White's center is reinforced.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 7...Nc6 — 黑马加入中心争夺。
黑方第二马出动，加压中心。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 7...Nc6 - Black's second knight joins the fight.
Black develops another piece and increases pressure on the center.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 8.Bd3 — 象压制王翼，准备 Ne5！
白象在 d3，斜线瞄准 h7，同时为 Ne5 的落地扫清道路。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 8.Bd3 - Aim toward the kingside and prepare Ne5!
The bishop targets h7 and helps clear the way for the knight's central outpost.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 8...Qe7 — 黑后支援中心。
黑后加入控制，支撑 e5 格。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 8...Qe7 - Black's queen supports the center.
The queen adds control and reinforces e5.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 9.Ne5 — 中心马！8步积累的顶点！
马占据 e5，成为整个阵型的核心支柱。控制 c4、c6、d3、d7、f3、f7、g4、g6 共 8 个格！
★ 总结：每步白方都在积累控制——Nf3→d4→Bf4→Bg3→Nbd2→Bd3→Ne5，这就是子力控制的积累之道！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 9.Ne5 - The central knight crowns the buildup!
The knight occupies e5, the key support of White's formation, and controls eight squares: c4, c6, d3, d7, f3, f7, g4, and g6.
★ Summary: White accumulated control move by move: Nf3, d4, Bf4, Bg3, Nbd2, Bd3, and finally Ne5.
